'''Sarrano Yard''' was a shipbuilding facility owned by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and located on [[Serres Sarrano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The facility was capable of producing spacecraft that were 77 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] or shorter.<ref name="Strongholds" />

Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Sarrano Yard produced [[Ambassador-class shuttle|''Ambassador''-class luxury shuttles]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Yard began to produce [[Cutlass-9 patrol fighter|''Cutlass-9'' patrol craft]] that were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
